scope: Corollary 7.9 (Passive scalar return) of the manuscript “Quasipolynomial Bounds for Arithmetic Progressions” (preprints/Quasipolynomial-Bounds-for-Arithmetic-Progressions-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 159 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 481eaf7730dc4d58), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 59. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: After Proposition 7.8, one can select a modular-good path and its retained warm-cost subslice for which the forecasting measure K of Lemma 7.3 has a signed surplus of warm size. After one further small proportional target discount, its parallel residue matching can be imposed modulo an integer M∗ with warm logarithmic cost. The site payoffs still evaluate the original cutoffs on gU (u), with the exact old determining conditions.
